//: Feature 31, the Fairy King's ONE bargain (pack Prompt 46). Offered while hw_stat_king_bargain is 0 (the marker, hidden 0/1, rate 0: once a run). Line.DefaultText: So, a mortal has found my ring. I will give you two fairy stones, bright as the day they were made. All I ask is a little of your will; you will hardly miss it.

Answer.DefaultText: Take my will, and give me the stones.
